products.manufacturerLegalName: Zhejiang Zahndent Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (per marketplace supplier listings)
products.name: ZDM-E5 Dental Lab Milling Machine
products.tagline: The all-in-one starter mill: five-axis dry milling for zirconia, PMMA, wax and PEEK.
products.description: Zahndent presents the ZDM-E5 as an all-in-one starter milling machine for dental laboratories. It mills crowns, copings, bridges and inlays/onlays from 98 mm discs in five axes, using a water-cooled 1.2 kW Haozhi spindle that reaches 60,000 RPM and an automatic six-position tool changer. It is operated from a touch display, and the window door at the front opens upward for loading. CAM is HyperDent.
labValue: An entry point into in-house milling: zirconia, PMMA, wax and PEEK without outsourcing.
Automatic tool change across six positions lets long jobs run unattended; Zahndent states each DC-coated bur carves about 600 teeth.
Zahndent states a full-arch cut takes about 1.5 hours, with an average zirconia crown time of 8 to 15 minutes.
Mills from standard 98 mm discs, the common disc format across the industry.

features.title: 5-axis machining
features.text: Five-axis milling with 90° cutting for more flexible engraving of complex anatomy (manufacturer claim).

features.title: Haozhi water-cooled spindle
features.text: 1.2 kW, 20,000–60,000 RPM. Zahndent states the water cooling extends spindle life and allows 24-hour operation.

features.title: Six-tool magazine

features.title: Free calibration

features.title: Dry milling
features.text: Configured for dry milling of zirconia, wax, PMMA and PEEK.

features.title: Touch operation & HyperDent
features.text: Touch display on the machine; supplied for use with HyperDent CAM software. Servo motors drive the axes.

The cabinet in upload #1 carries the IDT brand. It is not a listed Zahndent accessory for the E5, so its dimensions and specs are unknown.
Both mill photos carry an AI-image sparkle mark in the corner. Confirm that they accurately represent the device as sold.
Price, lead time, regional certification (CE/FDA) and local warranty terms from IDT.

products.name: AI-S3 High-Speed Desktop Lab Scanner
products.tagline: Blue-light desktop scanner: single arch in 8.5 s, ≤0.006 mm accuracy, true-color texture.
products.description: A high-speed desktop scanner for dental labs, built on blue-light fringe (grating) projection with dual 2.4 MP cameras. It digitises models, dies and impressions, with true-color texture at one click, and exports open STL, PLY and OBJ data for exocad, 3Shape and other CAD software. Aident specifies ≤0.006 mm accuracy (ISO 12836) and a 94 × 89 × 60 mm scan area, and positions it for high-volume batch work.
labValue: Speed for batch orders: 1 s occlusion, 8.5 s single arch, 18 s full impression (Aident brochure).
Direct impression scanning skips the gypsum model; double-sided impressions are aligned automatically.
AI screw-channel closure fills implant scan-body channels automatically, so implant data goes to CAD without manual repair.
Open data (STL/PLY/OBJ) goes straight into exocad or 3Shape without trimming or gap filling.

features.title: Blue-light grating projection
features.text: Structured blue-light optics filter ambient light; Aident specifies full-arch accuracy within 6 µm.

features.title: AI screw-channel closure
features.text: Automatically seals screw-channel gaps when scanning implant models.

features.title: AI teeth sorting & order dispatch
features.text: Software identifies 25 tooth positions in 2 seconds and matches them to order boxes, guided by buzzer and LED (Aident brochure).

features.title: True-color texture
features.text: One-click switch to HD color texture for margin marking and aesthetic reference.

features.title: Direct impression scanning
features.text: Double-sided, post-core, half and quarter impressions without pouring a model.

features.title: Open CAD export
features.text: STL, PLY and OBJ output; works with exocad and 3Shape.

products.name: S9 High-Temperature Speed Sintering Furnace
products.tagline: Speed sintering of translucent zirconia up to 1700 °C.
products.description: A high-temperature lift-type furnace for speed sintering translucent zirconia. It sinters up to 25 single crowns per cycle at up to 1700 °C. Three molybdenum-disilicide elements heat the chamber from all sides, and an electrically driven lifting table makes loading easier. It suits chairside production and urgent laboratory work.
labValue: Speed cycles mean urgent zirconia cases can leave the lab sooner.
Holds three crucible layers at once, for up to 25 single crowns per cycle.
Ships with 100 programs, including presets for common zirconia blocks.
The NeunoRton app shows cycle progress on a phone and sends a notification if a fault occurs.

products.name: M9 High-Temperature Sintering Furnace
products.tagline: Compact front-loading sintering for crowns and bridges.
products.description: A compact, front-loading high-temperature furnace for sintering crowns and bridges made of translucent zirconia. It can be programmed for the recommended sintering curves of almost all zirconia manufacturers, and its MoSi₂ heating elements are dental-specific.
labValue: Can be programmed for the sintering curves of almost all zirconia brands.
Power-off memory resumes the program after a power interruption.
A drying function removes residual moisture before sintering.
Smaller footprint than the S9, at 361 × 360 × 555 mm.

products.identificationEvidence: The uploaded image is identical in composition to the official M9 product image (front door with handle, warning label and a clock reading 20:09 on the touch screen), so the model ID is secure. However, the official text contradicts itself, so some specifications are withheld.
missingInformation: Maximum temperature: the title and spec table say 1700 °C, but the body text says 1560 °C. 1700 °C is shown with a 'to be confirmed' flag.

The official text mentions an 'electrically driven lifting table', a 'cylindrical chamber' and 'forced cooling: the furnace opens step by step'. These appear to be copied from the lift-type models and conflict with the front-door box design in the photo, so they are not published.
Heating rate is given as both '<100 °C/min' and '10o °C/min', and fastest cycle as both '3.5 hours' and 'under 2.5 hours'. Neither is published.
Number of programs is not stated.

products.manufacturerLegalName: Zhongshan NeunoRton Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Co., Ltd.
products.name: M5 Vacuum Porcelain Furnace
products.tagline: Vacuum porcelain firing to 1200 °C with built-in ceramic programs.
products.description: A lift-type vacuum porcelain furnace for firing dental ceramics, including glass ceramics. The chamber is heated on all sides with dental-specific high-purity heating wire, and an oil-free vacuum pump reaches −98 kPa. Programs for Ivoclar, Vita and Noritake porcelain are built in.
labValue: Heating from all sides gives a uniform temperature field, so fired results are more consistent.
Built-in programs for major porcelain brands reduce manual programming.
The oil-free vacuum pump is described as maintenance-free and quiet.
At 20 kg, the furnace fits on a technician's bench.
